name: OpenStreetMap
description: Buildings, roads, parks, water and land surface from OpenStreetMap, loaded through Autark for a box or for named areas. Each building, road, park and water row is one OpenStreetMap way or relation, with its tags and its id; heights, widths, speeds and counts are numbers.

parameters.label: Area
parameters.description: A box, or the areas inside a place as OpenStreetMap names their boundaries.

resources.name: Buildings
resources.description: Buildings and building parts, one row each; building_id names the building each belongs to. Sheds, garages, carports and other small structures are left out.

resources.name: Roads
resources.description: Streets, roads, tracks and paths, as lines, without footways, cycleways, steps or pedestrian streets.

resources.name: Parks
resources.description: Parks, playgrounds, woods, grass, cemeteries and other green space.

resources.name: Water
resources.description: Lakes, ponds, reservoirs, river areas and wetlands.

resources.name: Surface
resources.description: The land inside the area: the box, or the named areas' outline.

resources.name: All layers
resources.description: Buildings, roads, parks, water and surface, as one group of five datasets.
